retired: knowing-fibre status layer, mock urge modules and chemistry scaffolds
classification: Every declaration was read. A declaration was retired when its content is one of: a status flag or enum (modality, wired, green, authority path, cell id, non-claim string) or a theorem about one; a statement restating its own file's literals; a rfl alias of another declaration; a computation over a stub (a DensityMatrix defined as Unit or as a bare number, a mutual information that ignores the state, a step function that returns its input); or a fixture keyed by an invented node or cell name.

UrgeKnowing (Lean, Coq, Agda, Haskell; 1.content: Each module redefined DensityMatrix as a stub and EpistemicMI as a constant, so its theorems held for any state by construction; ten modules repeated the same rfl wrapper of Excitement.select; MachineTemperature hard-coded k_B as the integer 138 and mapped 0 K to 1 K; ObserveMinMi's independent and correlated states were the same value; TwoHilberts' Hilbert index was row-major order; PadmaObservationCost held two false flags.

uninhabited hypothesis records (Agda, Co.content: Agda MirrorScope.LandauerSecondLaw and MirrorScope.GatePhysicalModel and Coq MirrorScope.GatePhysicalModel asserted the second law or psi-antitonicity for every process or every state record, types with no inhabitant, so results derived under them were vacuous. Agda DensityMatrixProps and ComplementarityProps asserted density-matrix constraints and Englert's inequality for arbitrary records. They are retired: Agda DensityMatrix2 now carries its constraints and ComplementaritySpec.englert proves V^2 + D^2 <= 1 from them, as Coq does.
